167353.「行きはよいよい 帰りは怖い……。:
The journey there is pleasant, all things
considered. The return trip though?
That's scary.

167354.「邪気をはろうた あざやかな手並み\n ……よろしおすなぁ。:
A brilliant display of skill. Truly, you did
a splendid job exercising that Demon.

167355.「せやけど 背中には 注意しいや。\n 亡者どもは 常に背後から 忍び寄るんやか:
But watch your back. Demons are always
creeping up behind you.

167356.「ウチは 天地雷鳴士の陰の分家\n ……陰衆の頭領 ヨイ いいます。:
My name is Yoi, the leader of the Yin Clan.
We are known as the Druids of Shadow.
The Inshu.

167357.「あんたが 陽衆の新人はんやね。 \n 能天気女に たぶらかされはって\n かわ:
You must be that rookie Druid from the
Yang Clan. It's pitiful to see you led astray
by that scatterbrained woman.

167358.「ウチら陰衆は 呪術の名手……。\n 天地雷鳴士として 強うなりたいんなら\n:
We, the Inshu, are the true masters of the mystical arts. If you want to become stronger as a druid, you're welcome to join to us
anytime you want.

167360.「もしも これからも 陽衆を名乗るんなら\n せいぜい背中には 気ぃつけなはれ。:
If you're going to keep calling yourself a
member of the Yang Clan then you'd best watch
 your back.
